svg.title: Databricks Apps — Genie Space + LLM Serving Endpoint architecture
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom flowchart: User submits a question, it flows through prompt enhancement, Genie Space, response structuring, and the Dash App, with the final answer returned to the user via a right-side return arrow. A one-click case creation action branches off the Dash App.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who are the users of this app?')
sendPrompt('How does the prompt enhancement step work?')
sendPrompt('How does Genie Space process the query?')
sendPrompt('What role does Unity Catalog play here?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM structure Genie responses?')
sendPrompt('What does the Dash App display to users?')
sendPrompt('How does the case creation feature work?')
